reg_deadline.en: Registration closed October 5, 2026. Texas has no same-day or Election Day registration. Moved to a new Texas county and didn't register there? If you're still registered in your old county, you may be able to vote a limited ballot, with the races both counties share, at your new county's main early voting location through Friday, October 30. Not on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el 5 de octubre de 2026. Texas no tiene registro el mismo día ni el Día de las Elecciones. ¿Te mudaste a otro condado de Texas y no te registraste ahí? Si sigues registrado en tu condado anterior, quizás puedas votar con una boleta limitada (limited ballot), con las contiendas que comparten los dos condados, en el centro principal de votación anticipada de tu nuevo condado hasta el viernes 30 de octubre. No el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: If you have moved to a new county and have not re-registered in the new county by the October 5, 2026 deadline, you may be eligible to vote a limited ballot in your new county. A limited ballot means that you would be allowed to vote on any candidates and measures in common between your former and new county. This procedure is only available during the early voting period at the main early voting polling place ; you may NOT vote a limited ballot on election day.
reg_deadline.en_after: Registration closed October 5, 2026. Texas has no same-day or Election Day registration, and the limited ballot for voters who moved counties was only available during early voting.
reg_deadline.es_after: El registro cerró el 5 de octubre de 2026. Texas no tiene registro el mismo día ni el Día de las Elecciones, y la boleta limitada para quienes se mudaron de condado solo estaba disponible durante la votación anticipada.
reg_deadline.notes: Oct 5 deadline also on sos.state.tx.us important-election-dates (read 2026-10-21). Same FAQ: must be a current registered voter in the former county (or registered there when applying in the new county).

mail_request.en: Your county's early voting clerk must receive your application by Friday, October 23, 2026.
mail_request.es: La oficina electoral de tu condado debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar el viernes 23 de octubre de 2026.
mail_request.quote: Last day to receive application for ballot by mail: Friday, October 23, 2026

mail_return.en: In hand by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, or postmarked by 7 p.m. that day and received by 5 p.m. on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Overseas and military deadlines differ.
mail_return.es: Debe llegar a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre, o tener matasellos de las 7 p. m. de ese día o antes y llegar a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del miércoles 4 de noviembre de 2026. Los plazos para votantes en el extranjero y militares son distintos.
mail_return.quote: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 (next business day after Election Day) at 5:00 p.m. if carrier envelope is postmarked by 7:00 p.m. at the location of the election on Election Day

early_hours.en: Early voting ends Friday, October 30. Each county sets the hours for its sites. Through Friday, each county's main early voting location must be open at least 12 hours a day. Check your county elections office for times.
early_hours.es: La votación anticipada termina el viernes 30 de octubre. Cada condado fija el horario de sus centros. Hasta el viernes, el centro principal de votación anticipada de cada condado debe abrir por lo menos 12 horas al día. Consulta los horarios con la oficina electoral de tu condado.
early_hours.quote: Early voting hours for the main early-voting polling place are as follows: ... October 25 26 27 28 29 30 31 At least 6 hours At least 12 hours At least 12 hours At least 12 hours At least 12 hours At least 12 hours None
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended Friday, October 30. Vote on Election Day, November 3, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el viernes 30 de octubre. Vota el Día de las Elecciones, 3 de noviembre, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
early_hours.notes: Oct 30 end date also on sos.state.tx.us important-election-dates ('Last Day of Early Voting by Personal Appearance Friday, October 30, 2026'). Advisory table read by curl 2026-10-28.

cure.en: Got a notice of a defect on your mail ballot? Correct it by Monday, November 9, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Recibiste un aviso de un error en tu boleta por correo? Corrígelo a más tardar el lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.en_after: The deadline to correct a mail ballot defect was Monday, November 9, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para corregir un error en la boleta por correo fue el lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: You have until the 6th day after Election Day to correct the defect in order for your ballot to be counted.

in_person.en: During early voting you can vote at any early voting location in the county where you live. On Election Day, it depends on your county: counties in the Countywide Polling Place Program let you vote at any location in the county, and the rest send you to your assigned precinct.
in_person.es: Durante la votación anticipada puedes votar en cualquier lugar de votación anticipada del condado donde vives. El Día de las Elecciones depende de tu condado: los condados del programa de lugares de votación en todo el condado (Countywide Polling Place Program) te dejan votar en cualquier lugar del condado, y los demás te asignan tu precinto.
in_person.quote: Registered and eligible voters may vote at ANY early voting location located in their county of residence.

locator_label.en: My Voter Portal (Texas Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: My Voter Portal (Secretaría de Estado de Texas)

rule.en: My Voter Portal shows your registration and where you can vote. Your county elections office lists early voting sites and their hours.
rule.es: My Voter Portal muestra tu registro y dónde puedes votar. La oficina electoral de tu condado publica los lugares de votación anticipada y sus horarios.
rule.quote: Election Day voting hours are 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. at all polling places statewide.

en: U.S. military ID card with your photo
U.S. citizenship certificate with your photo
es: Certificado de Identificación Electoral de Texas (Election Identification Certificate)
Tarjeta de identificación personal de Texas
Licencia de portación de armas de Texas (handgun license)
Tarjeta de identificación militar de EE. UU. con tu foto
Certificado de ciudadanía de EE. UU. con tu foto
Pasaporte de EE. UU., libreta o tarjeta

expired.en: If you are 18 to 69, your ID can be expired up to four years. If you are 70 or older, it can be expired for any length of time. The citizenship certificate doesn't expire.
expired.es: Si tienes de 18 a 69 años, tu identificación puede tener hasta cuatro años de vencida. Si tienes 70 años o más, puede estar vencida por cualquier tiempo. El certificado de ciudadanía no vence.
expired.quote: may be expired for any length of time if the identification is otherwise valid

without.en: Don't have one of these and can't reasonably get one? You can still vote a regular ballot. Bring one supporting document, such as your voter registration certificate, a certified birth certificate, or a current utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, government check or other government document with your name and an address. Then sign a short form called a Reasonable Impediment Declaration.
without.es: ¿No tienes una de estas y no puedes conseguirla por una razón válida? Todavía puedes votar con una boleta regular. Lleva un documento de apoyo, como tu certificado de registro de votante, un acta de nacimiento certificada, o un recibo de servicios reciente, un estado de cuenta bancario, un talón de pago, un cheque del gobierno u otro documento del gobierno con tu nombre y una dirección. Luego firma un formulario corto llamado declaración de impedimento razonable (Reasonable Impediment Declaration).
without.quote: Here is a list of the supporting forms of ID that can be presented if the voter does not possess one of the forms of acceptable photo ID and cannot reasonably obtain one: copy or original of a government document that shows the voter’s name and an address, including the voter’s voter registration certificate; copy of or original current utility bill; copy of or original bank statement; copy of or original government check; copy of or original paycheck; or copy of or original of (a) a certified domestic (from a U.S. state or territory) birth certificate

who.en: You can vote by mail in Texas if you:
who.es: Puedes votar por correo en Texas si:
who.quote: are 65 years of age or older on Election Day; or

cure.en: Missing signature, a signature that doesn't match, or missing ID or witness information? You'll get a notice with a corrective action form on the back. Return it by mail or in person, or fix an ID number online in the Ballot by Mail Tracker, by Monday, November 9.
cure.es: ¿Te faltó la firma, no coincide, o faltan datos de identificación o del testigo? Recibirás un aviso con un formulario de corrección al reverso. Devuélvelo por correo o en persona, o corrige el número de identificación en línea con el rastreador de boletas por correo de la Secretaría de Estado, a más tardar el lunes 9 de noviembre.
cure.quote: You have until the 6th day after Election Day to correct the defect in order for your ballot to be counted.
cure.en_after: The deadline to correct a mail ballot defect was Monday, November 9, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para corregir un error en la boleta por correo fue el lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026.

dropbox.en: Texas has no drop boxes. Your marked ballot can go back by mail, by a delivery company, or by you in person to the early voting clerk's office, only while polls are open on Election Day and with an accepted ID. No one else can drop it off for you. Changed your mind? Bring the mail ballot with you and hand it in at a polling place so you can vote in person. Without it, you can vote only a provisional ballot.
dropbox.es: Texas no tiene buzones de entrega. Puedes devolver tu boleta marcada por correo, por una compañía de mensajería o en persona en la oficina del secretario de votación anticipada (early voting clerk). En persona, solo mientras estén abiertos los lugares de votación el Día de las Elecciones y con una identificación aceptada. Nadie más la puede entregar por ti. ¿Cambiaste de opinión? Lleva tu boleta por correo y entrégala en un lugar de votación para poder votar en persona. Sin ella, solo puedes votar con una boleta provisional.
dropbox.quote: The carrier envelope may be delivered in another envelope and must be transported and delivered only by: (1) mail; (2) common or contract carrier; or (3) subject to Subsections (a-1) and (a-2), in-person delivery by the voter who voted the ballot. (a-1) The voter may deliver a marked ballot in person to the early voting clerk's office only while the polls are open on election day. A voter who delivers a marked ballot in person must present an acceptable form of identification described by Section 63.0101.
dropbox.notes: Read via tcss.legis.texas.gov mirror 2026-10-28 (statutes.capitol.texas.gov serves a JS shell to curl). Cancel-and-vote-in-person rests on EL.84: 84.032(d) lets the voter return the mail ballot to the early voting clerk at an early voting site or the presiding judge on Election Day; 84.035(b) limits a voter who cancels without returning it to a provisional ballot. 84.032(c) also allows an affidavit if the ballot never arrived; not on page.

witness.en: If someone helps you with your mail ballot, their name and address go on the carrier envelope and they sign it.
witness.es: Si alguien te ayuda con tu boleta por correo, su nombre y dirección van en el sobre de envío y esa persona lo firma.
witness.quote: your helper's name and address must be on the carrier envelope

en: are 65 or older on Election Day
are expected to give birth within three weeks before or after Election Day
will be away from your county on Election Day and during early voting hours
are confined in jail or involuntary civil commitment but otherwise eligible
es: tienes 65 años o más el Día de las Elecciones
estás enfermo o tienes una discapacidad
esperas dar a luz en las tres semanas antes o después del Día de las Elecciones
vas a estar fuera de tu condado el Día de las Elecciones y durante el horario de votación anticipada
estás en la cárcel o bajo internamiento civil involuntario pero puedes votar
who_list.quote: are 65 years of age or older on Election Day; or

gear.en: Leave the campaign shirts and hats at home. Within 100 feet of any outside door to the polling place, you can't wear a badge, button or anything else about a candidate, party or measure on the ballot. Political signs and handouts are out in that zone too, and within 20 feet of curbside voting spaces.
gear.es: Deja en casa las camisetas y gorras de campaña. A menos de 100 pies de cualquier puerta exterior del lugar de votación no puedes llevar una insignia, un botón ni nada sobre un candidato, un partido o una propuesta que aparezca en la boleta. Los letreros y folletos políticos también están prohibidos en esa zona, y a menos de 20 pies de los espacios para votar desde el auto.
gear.quote: a person may not wear a badge, insignia, emblem, or other similar communicative device relating to a candidate, measure, or political party appearing on the ballot, or to the conduct of the election, in the polling place or within 100 feet of any outside door

phone.en: Keep your phone put away in the room where voting happens. Texas bans recording images or sound within 100 feet of a voting station, so take your sticker selfie outside and well away from the door.
phone.es: En el cuarto donde se vota, mantén tu teléfono guardado. Texas prohíbe grabar imágenes o sonido a menos de 100 pies de una cabina de votación, así que tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera y lejos de la puerta.
phone.quote: (a) Except as permitted by Sections 61.012 and 61.013, a person may not use a wireless communication device within a room in which voting is taking place. (b) A person may not use any mechanical or electronic means of recording images or sound within 100 feet of a voting station.

line.en: Inside or in line at your polling place at 7 p.m.? Stay. You can still vote.
line.es: ¿Estás adentro o en la fila de tu lugar de votación a las 7 p. m.? Quédate. Todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: (a) A voter who has not voted before the time for closing the polls is entitled to vote after that time if the voter is inside or waiting to enter the polling place at 7 p.m.

tradition.en: In El Paso County, voters get student-designed stickers during the 2026 elections. Novalie, then a 10th grader at Eastwood High School, drew the I Voted sticker. Sophia, then a 4th grader at Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, drew the Future Voter sticker. They won first place in the county's 2025 sticker contest, out of 162 entries.
tradition.es: En el condado de El Paso, los votantes reciben stickers diseñados por estudiantes durante las elecciones de 2026. Novalie, que entonces cursaba 10.º grado en Eastwood High School, dibujó el sticker I Voted. Sophia, que entonces cursaba 4.º grado en Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, dibujó el sticker Future Voter. Ganaron el primer lugar en el concurso de stickers 2025 del condado, entre 162 diseños.
tradition.en_after: For the 2026 elections, El Paso County handed out student-designed stickers. Novalie, then a 10th grader at Eastwood High School, drew the I Voted sticker. Sophia, then a 4th grader at Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, drew the Future Voter sticker. They won first place in the county's 2025 sticker contest, out of 162 entries.
tradition.es_after: En las elecciones de 2026, el condado de El Paso repartió stickers diseñados por estudiantes. Novalie, que entonces cursaba 10.º grado en Eastwood High School, dibujó el sticker I Voted. Sophia, que entonces cursaba 4.º grado en Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, dibujó el sticker Future Voter. Ganaron el primer lugar en el concurso de stickers 2025 del condado, entre 162 diseños.
tradition.quote: First-place winning designs will be distributed to voters during the 2026 election season. ... “This year, we received 162 submissions compared to the 68 submissions for the last midterm election year.
tradition.notes: Release dated November 14, 2025 (2025 contest, designs used in 2026). Reread Oct 28 in Chrome. Full names on the page; first name, grade and school here. The release names Sophia's school as Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School.

early.en: In Williamson County, yes, while supplies last. Its 2026 student-designed stickers are handed out from the first day of early voting, October 19, through Election Day, November 3. Austin, an eighth grader at Santa Rita Ranch Middle School, and Brinda, a 12th grader at Rouse High School, won first place in the I Voted contest. Felicity, a second grader at Naumann Elementary School, won first place for the Future Voter sticker.
early.es: En el condado de Williamson, sí, mientras duren. Sus stickers de 2026 diseñados por estudiantes se reparten desde el primer día de votación anticipada, el 19 de octubre, hasta el Día de las Elecciones, el 3 de noviembre. Austin, estudiante de 8.º grado de Santa Rita Ranch Middle School, y Brinda, estudiante de 12.º grado de Rouse High School, ganaron el primer lugar en el concurso de I Voted. Felicity, estudiante de 2.º grado de Naumann Elementary School, ganó el primer lugar con el sticker Future Voter.
early.en_after: In Williamson County, the 2026 student-designed stickers were handed out in limited supply from the first day of early voting, October 19, through Election Day. Austin, an eighth grader at Santa Rita Ranch Middle School, and Brinda, a 12th grader at Rouse High School, won first place in the I Voted contest. Felicity, a second grader at Naumann Elementary School, won first place for the Future Voter sticker.
early.es_after: En el condado de Williamson, los stickers de 2026 diseñados por estudiantes se repartieron, en cantidad limitada, desde el primer día de votación anticipada, el 19 de octubre, hasta el Día de las Elecciones. Austin, estudiante de 8.º grado de Santa Rita Ranch Middle School, y Brinda, estudiante de 12.º grado de Rouse High School, ganaron el primer lugar en el concurso de I Voted. Felicity, estudiante de 2.º grado de Naumann Elementary School, ganó el primer lugar con el sticker Future Voter.
early.quote: Winning sticker designs will be available in limited supply during voting, beginning with the first day of early voting on Oct. 19 and continuing through Election Day on Nov. 3, 2026. ... First place: Felicity, second grade, Naumann Elementary School (Leander ISD) ... First place: Austin, eighth grade, Santa Rita Ranch Middle School (Liberty Hill ISD) ... First place: Brinda, 12th grade, Rouse High School (Leander ISD)
early.notes: Read Oct 28 in Chrome (curl and WebFetch get a 403). Linked from wilcotx.gov/2019/2026-Sticker-Contest, which says the middle and high school winners 'will become the official "I Voted" stickers for the upcoming election.' The page gives students' surnames; removed here and in the quote. The page shows the designs as images with no alt text, so no design descriptions. Replaces the Gaines County answer (newtools.cira.state.tx.us/page/gaines.ElectionsStickerpage, 'The sticker will be distributed to voters at all Early Voting Locations and Election Day Vote Centers during the 2026 elections.', checked Oct 23).

mail.en: In El Paso County, save a digital one. The county elections department posts a free digital "I Voted" sticker for mail voters: save the image to your phone or computer. In another county? Ask your county elections office.
mail.es: En el condado de El Paso, guarda uno digital. El departamento electoral del condado tiene un sticker digital gratuito de "I Voted" para quienes votan por correo: guarda la imagen en tu teléfono o computadora. ¿Vives en otro condado? Pregunta en la oficina electoral de tu condado.
mail.quote: Digital Stickers Thank you for voting by mail! We still wanted to make sure you're able to celebrate casting your vote, so we've created a digital "I Voted" sticker. Save one of the images below on your phone or computer.
mail.notes: Read by curl 2026-10-29. The section sits on the county's military and overseas voting page; the page is undated, so the copy doesn't say when the sticker started. Lead from the Oct 29 Perplexity Deep Research read (texas.md).

provisional.en: You vote a provisional ballot when poll workers can't verify your registration, or when you have an accepted photo ID but didn't bring it. In that case, take the ID to your county voter registrar's office within six days after Election Day, by Monday, November 9, or your ballot won't count. You'll get a notice in the mail telling you whether it counted. Name not on the list? Your voter registration certificate and an accepted photo ID may let you vote a regular ballot instead.
provisional.es: Votas con una boleta provisional cuando los trabajadores electorales no pueden verificar tu registro, o cuando tienes una identificación con foto aceptada pero no la llevaste. En ese caso, lleva la identificación a la oficina del registrador de votantes de tu condado (voter registrar) dentro de los seis días después del Día de las Elecciones, a más tardar el lunes 9 de noviembre, o tu boleta no contará. Te llegará un aviso por correo que te dice si contó. ¿Tu nombre no aparece en la lista? Tu certificado de registro de votante (voter registration certificate) y una identificación con foto aceptada pueden permitirte votar con una boleta regular.
provisional.quote: If a voter states that they (a) do not possess an acceptable form of photo identification listed above, and the voter can reasonably obtain one of these acceptable forms of identification or (b) possesses, but did not bring to the polling place, one of the seven forms of acceptable photo identification listed above, the voter may cast a provisional ballot at the polls. However, in order to have the provisional ballot counted, the voter will be required to visit the voter registrar’s office within six calendar days of the date of the election to present one of the above forms of photo ID
provisional.notes: Sixth calendar day after Nov 3 = Mon Nov 9 (computed). Registration-verification reason and mailed notice are from votetexas.gov/faq (read 2026-10-21: notice 'by the 10th day after the local canvass'); 'by the 10th day' detail dropped for length. Oct 29 (loop 1): last sentence from votetexas.gov/faq, read by WebFetch and matching the Perplexity quote: 'if your name does not appear on the official list of registered voters in the precinct, you may be able to cast a regular ballot by presenting your valid voter registration certificate along with an acceptable form of photo identification.'

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone inside or waiting to enter their polling place at 7 p.m. gets to vote.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté adentro o esperando para entrar a su lugar de votación a las 7 p. m. puede votar.
line.quote: (a) A voter who has not voted before the time for closing the polls is entitled to vote after that time if the voter is inside or waiting to enter the polling place at 7 p.m.

track.en: Use the Ballot by Mail Tracker on the Texas Secretary of State's My Voter Portal once you've sent your ballot back. You'll need your name, date of birth, the last 4 digits of your Social Security number, and your Texas driver's license or DPS personal ID number.
track.es: Usa el rastreador de boletas por correo (Ballot by Mail Tracker) en el portal My Voter Portal de la Secretaría de Estado de Texas (Texas Secretary of State) después de enviar tu boleta. Necesitas tu nombre, tu fecha de nacimiento, los últimos 4 dígitos de tu número de Seguro Social y tu número de licencia de conducir de Texas o de identificación personal del DPS.
track.quote: Once you've sent your ballot by mail to your county's Early Voting Clerk, you can check the status of your mail-in ballot through our Ballot by Mail Tracker, available on the Texas Secretary of State's 'My Voter Portal.' To track your mail-in ballot, you must enter the following information: First Name Last Name Date of Birth The last 4 digits of your Social Security Number Your Driver's License or Department of Public Safety Personal ID number
track.notes: Read in Chrome 2026-10-29 (votetexas.gov returns 403 to curl). Loop 1 election-week pass.

late_mail.en: Not if it's postmarked by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, and reaches your county's early voting clerk by 5 p.m. on Wednesday, November 4. Not sure it will make it? Hand it in yourself at the early voting clerk's office on Election Day while polls are open. Bring an accepted ID.
late_mail.es: No, si tiene matasellos de las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre o antes y llega al secretario de votación anticipada de tu condado (early voting clerk) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del miércoles 4 de noviembre. ¿No sabes si llegará a tiempo? Entrégala tú en persona en la oficina del secretario de votación anticipada el Día de las Elecciones, mientras estén abiertos los lugares de votación. Lleva una identificación aceptada.
late_mail.quote: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 (next business day after Election Day) at 5:00 p.m. if carrier envelope is postmarked by 7:00 p.m. at the location of the election on Election Day (unless overseas or military voter deadlines apply)
late_mail.notes: Loop 1 election-week pass 2026-10-29; built from the state's verified return deadline and in-person return rule.

notes: Read October 21, 2026. Early voting minimum hours (Election Code 85.005), the cure deadline, the ballot tracker URL and the in-line-at-closing rule were not confirmed on an official page; left missing. Williamson County's sticker contest page blocks automated reading. The ID rule class follows docs/faq-sources.json (photo_requested: a Reasonable Impediment Declaration lets a voter without photo ID vote a regular ballot).

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 (Election Day) 7:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m. Polls open. (Sec. 41.031).
